name: Michael Murillo-Martinez
title: Software Engineer II | Founder & Product Engineer
summary: Software Engineer II and founder with 4+ years shipping production systems across regulated gaming, fintech, client services, and SaaS. Architected internal DevOps and release infrastructure at AGS, then designed, sold, deployed, and operated accessible web and automation products for real businesses. Full-stack across C#/.NET, Python, cloud, data, payments, and AI-assisted workflows.

experience.summary: Architected the company's DevOps portal and SVN release-tooling suite from the ground up, then owned end-to-end release management for regulated slot platforms across multiple gaming jurisdictions. AGS was subsequently acquired for $1B.
bullets: Architected and built the company's DevOps portal from the ground up — a unified hub connecting internal tools, release pipelines, compliance workflows, and documentation used daily by 5–10 engineers across QA and development. AGS was subsequently acquired for $1B.

Designed a microservices architecture that unified fragmented legacy programs into a connected system via a central hub, including a WPF decryption tool, File Handler, SVN automation services, email notification pipelines, and queue-based workflow processing.

Built SVN Tools suite — Branch Creator, Branch Unlocker, Build Validator, ChangeSet Manager, and Jurisdiction Map — eliminating manual release bottlenecks and enabling compliant delivery across multiple gaming jurisdictions.

Owned end-to-end release management across AGS slot platforms: coordinating engineering and QA, validating builds, tracking defects and smoke tests, and driving compliant delivery across jurisdictions.
Diagnosed and resolved production and field issues across firmware, UI, backend, and database layers on AGS slot platforms using C#, C++, Unity, Bash, SQL, XML, SAS, and JSON.

bullets: Founded M3MM to design and ship production web and automation systems for small businesses; delivered live client work including Big7 Construction and a sold Aries Outdoor Living site.
